description: D2 classical RAPTOR-equivalent baseline: parameter-space ensemble smoother over the TORAX current-diffusion solver, with a single EKI magnetics update via gs/operator.py and the SHARED mse_eval readout. The bar the S9 neural filter must beat.
forward_model: TORAX 1.1.1 (current-diffusion; circular geometry; sigma(Te) neoclassical closure; psi/current equation only)
inputs_measured_non_mse: amc PF coil currents (known H term)
observation_operator: gs/operator.py EFIT-free GS Greens-function forward map (j -> c_plasma[A] via cell-area weight -> predicted amb)
readout_shared: statespace/mse_eval.pitch_from_current_profile (current->pitch) + invert_pitch_to_q0rax (pitch->q0/rax) — IDENTICAL to the neural filter so the comparison isolates state inference
